title: Add runbook links to experiment alerts + Console guardrail banners
author: Rafael Mendes
body: Problem: During beta we saw multiple slow triage loops where the on-call (and Support) had to ask around for the right runbook when an experiment guardrail alert fired (propagation lag, attribution drop rate, variant skew, etc.). We already have runbooks in Confluence, but the link isn’t present where the incident starts: alert payloads and the Console guardrail banners. This PR wires canonical runbook URLs into (1) alert payload annotations (so PagerDuty/Slack notifications carry a direct ‘Runbook’ link) and (2) Console guardrail banners on the experiment details/results pages. Scope: route experiments only (no global SRE alert conventions refactor in this PR). What changed: - Added a small, versioned mapping of {alert_key -> runbook_url} for experiment-related alerts (propagation lag, attribution drop rate, variant 0 traffic, allocation skew, p99 regression auto-stop). - Plumbed runbook_url through the alert/notification payload used by the guardrail evaluator and the notifications pipeline. - Updated Console guardrail banner model to accept an optional runbook_url and render a ‘View runbook’ CTA when present. - Added safeguards: if an alert key is unknown or the URL is missing/invalid, we omit the link (no broken UI, no malformed payload). - Added unit tests for mapping + URL validation and an integration test that asserts the runbook link is present end-to-end for a representative guardrail event. Runbook sources (canonical): - Experiment assignment debugging runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGPLAT/Experiment+Assignment+Debugging+Runbook - Experiment health dashboards spec (links out to dashboards/runbooks): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGPLAT/Experiment+Health+Dashboards+Spec Notes: - This intentionally does not change Grafana rule definitions in observability-pack; it only ensures Redwood-originated notifications + Console surfaces carry the runbook URL. (Observability-pack PRs can independently add runbook_url annotations at rule level.) - URL allowlist: limited to confluence.redwoodinference.com to avoid arbitrary links in alert payloads. - Console UI is behind the existing route experiments feature flag; the banner rendering is a no-op if the backend doesn’t send runbook_url. Testing: - Unit: GuardrailAlertRunbookMapTest, UrlValidationTest - Integration: ExperimentGuardrailNotificationE2E (asserts runbook_url in notification payload + Console API response) Rollout: safe to ship with no config migrations; if we need to change runbook URLs, we can update the mapping and redeploy. Follow-ups: - Add runbook_url annotation in observability-pack alert rules so Grafana-native alerts match Redwood notifications. - Expand the mapping to cover non-experiment Rollouts alerts after GA if this proves useful.
commits: Add experiment alert key -> runbook URL mapping + URL validation
Plumb runbook_url through guardrail evaluator notification payload
Expose runbook_url in Console experiments guardrail API response
Console: render guardrail banner CTA when runbook_url is present
Tests: mapping/validation unit tests + E2E notification assertion
conversation: Sean Gallagher (review): Can we ensure we don’t ever emit arbitrary URLs? We’ve had issues where payload fields ended up being interpreted as clickable links in downstream tooling.
Rafael Mendes (author): Yep. Added a strict allowlist (confluence.redwoodinference.com only) + basic URL parsing. If validation fails, we omit runbook_url entirely.
Allison Grant (review): Naming: please keep the annotation key consistent with our existing conventions. We’ve been using runbook_url in alert payloads elsewhere.
Rafael Mendes (author): Updated to runbook_url everywhere (backend + Console response). Tests updated accordingly.
Logan Wright (review): Any risk of cardinality / metrics tagging impact?
Rafael Mendes (author): No metrics changes. This is only in notification payload + Console banner metadata.
Chloe Martin (review): Console API change looks good. One request: make sure the banner still renders cleanly if runbook_url missing. We have older guardrail rows in some environments.
Rafael Mendes (author): Added UI guard + API field is optional. Snapshot updated to cover missing runbook_url case.
Sean Gallagher (review): Please add a short note in the PR about observability-pack rule-level runbook annotations not being part of this change (to avoid confusion for on-call).
Rafael Mendes (author): Added in Notes section under scope.
release_notes: - Route experiments: guardrail alerts and Console guardrail banners now include direct links to the relevant on-call runbooks (when available).
